close_reason: Fixed move_to_dead_letter doc comment to accurately describe orphaned .env handling
description: The doc comment for move_to_dead_letter says: 'if the .env rename fails, the orphaned .env is still visible to drain_once — it will warn msg missing, skipping rather than permanently strand the .msg'. But drain_once's actual behavior when .msg is missing is: it logs 'orphaned .env (no matching .msg), removing' and deletes the .env file. It does not say 'msg missing, skipping'. The .msg is in dead/, the .env is cleaned up — the behavior is correct but the comment misstates it. Fix: rewrite the comment to match the actual drain_once behavior.
title: move_to_dead_letter doc comment misstates what happens to orphaned .env on next drain
